about: Server state of an active roll (dice roll with modifiers) that waits before it starts: the start request (Guid + byte, the same pair as esv::active_roll::StartRequestOneFrameComponent), two entity handles each followed by a list of 0x58-byte modifier entries, and a countdown. esv::active_roll::ModifierSystem::ProcessStartRequests creates it; ProcessWaitingActiveRollComponents (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xE44880; game ~bg3.exe+0x32D5CF0) finishes it at once when both lists are empty, otherwise subtracts the frame time from the countdown and, when it reaches 0, re-issues the request from +0/+0x10 (ActiveRollRequestData) and removes the component. Never seen alive. Registry total 80 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x32DD060 (AllocRaw 0x50) zeroes +0/+8. Toolkit ProcessWaitingActiveRollComponents passes the component and component + 0x10 to EoCServer.dll+0xE3B3B0, which stores 16 bytes from the first and one byte from the second into an ActiveRollRequestData (0x18) - the same pair as SE esv::active_roll::StartRequestOneFrameComponent {Guid field_0; uint8_t field_10} (Components/Roll.h); ProcessStartRequests copies 16 bytes + the byte at +0x10 the same way.
Creator writes byte 0 at +0x10; copied with the Guid as ActiveRollRequestData's byte (StartRequestOneFrameComponent.field_10).
Creator writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +0x18. Meaning not established.

Creator zeroes +0x20/+0x28 and the size at +0x2C; destructor bg3.exe+0x22A8EC0 calls bg3.exe+0x22E1500 with comp+0x20 and 0 (element stride 0x58) and frees the buffer. Toolkit ProcessWaitingActiveRollComponents tests whether the 32-bit integer at +0x2C (array size) is 0.
Creator writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +0x30. Meaning not established.
Creator zeroes +0x38/+0x40 and the size at +0x44; destructor calls bg3.exe+0x22E1500 with comp+0x38 and 0 (same element type). Toolkit tests whether the 32-bit integer at +0x44 is 0.

Creator writes 0x3f800000 (1.0f) at +0x48; Toolkit ProcessWaitingActiveRollComponents subtracts the float at +8 of the game time from the float at +0x48, stores the result back at +0x48, and when it is 0 or less starts the roll and removes the component.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
survey.names_pass_2: No game names: not saved, not replicated; the ModifierSourceInfo members follow SE.
open_questions: Meanings of the entry's byte at +0, Guid at +0x40 and bytes at +0x50/+0x51 (widths established by the Windows move).
Meaning of the handles at +0x18 / +0x30 (probably roller and target, each with its list of possible modifiers).
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
survey.second_pass: The 0x58-byte list entry was decoded from the Windows resize/move bg3.exe+0x22E1500 and its element destructor bg3.exe+0x7A19F0: a byte, an SE ModifierSourceInfo at +8, a Guid at +0x40 and two bytes; the component's own offsets were already from the Windows creator bg3.exe+0x32DD060 and destructor.

structs.name: ActiveRollWaitingSourceInfo
structs.equals: Script Extender ModifierSourceInfo (Components/Roll.h, 0x38 bytes), redeclared with enums as their underlying types

fields.name: SourceType
fields.evidence: SE ModifierSourceInfo.SourceType (BoostSourceType, uint8_t); bg3.exe+0x22E1500 (array resize of the 0x58-byte entries) moves the dword at entry +8 as one value.

fields.name: Cause
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x22E1500 (array resize of the 0x58-byte entries) moves entry +0xC and resets the source to 0xFFFFFFFF; bg3.exe+0x7A19F0, called on entry + 8, DecRefs +4 of the info - a FixedString. SE name.
